title: res.json & "json escape" should always return json
body: When using the "json escape" setting, `res.json` was returning `text/html` response when being called with a falsy value such as `undefined`. `JSON.stringify()` can return `undefined` so this guards against that before using `String.replace()`.

title: Fix regexp handing logic in router. Closes #4204
body:
It closes #4204. When regexp matches path not from the beginning, `trim_prefx` validates if path breaks on a path separator in a wrong way.

```

```

title: Check parent builder object for enabled status
body:
This fixes an issue where child builders do not propagate their enabled statuses to the parents and vice versa.

For example, prior to this PR:

```javascript
var chalk = require('chalk');

console.log(chalk.enabled); // true

var red = chalk.red;
console.log(red.enabled); // true

chalk.enabled = false;

console.log(red.enabled); // true  (should be false!)
```

title: Only trap key errors by default in debug, not all BadRequest errors
body:
closes #2735 

In order to make debugging key errors from `request.form` easier, #2348 trapped `BadRequest` errors by default in debug mode. However, this caught *all* `BadRequest` errors, not just `BadRequestKeyError`. This changes the behavior so `BadRequestKeyError` is caught in debug mode, but `abort(400)` still passes through.
